message:
Real export cancel — abort signal through port to killable Rust run (#383) (#442)

The キャンセル button only closed the dialog while export_run kept writing. Now ExportPort.export takes an AbortSignal: the dialog's cancel/X/Esc abort it, the port pairs an exportId with a new export_cancel command, and Rust checkpoints tear the staging dir down before commit — including killing the in-flight MuseScore child.
